user.title: Connect Eigenpuls
user.description: Eigenpuls carries health data from your iPhone to this Home Assistant. The next screen shows a code to scan with the app.

pair.title: Scan this with Eigenpuls
pair.description:
Open Eigenpuls on your iPhone and scan the code.

Then tap "Finish" below — the app connects on its own from there.

Can't scan? Copy the code below instead.

**Treat this connection code like a password.**

This connection also works when you are away from home.

reconfigure.title: Connect again
reconfigure.description: This creates new access data for the Eigenpuls app. The old code stops working immediately. Your existing data and history are not affected.

error.no_usable_url: Home Assistant has no address the iPhone can reach. Set an internal or external address under Settings › System › Network, then try again.
error.unusable_url: The address Home Assistant reports cannot be used for a secure connection. Use HTTPS, or an address on your home network.
error.missing_token: Something went wrong creating the access data. Please try again.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Access data created. If you have not scanned the code yet, use *Reconfigure* to create a new one — this one is not shown again.
